title: `/kaji/epoch-push` so every peer acknowledges the new epoch
goal: Reachable peers and workers persist maxSeenCoordinatorEpoch before the new main opens effects, and the acks are measured
privacy: Neutral fixtures only in git; real coordinator state, keys and device evidence remain private.
acceptance: nerv kaji relocate pushes the signed main record to reachable peers and workers over /kaji/epoch-push (HTTP) and open WebSockets; each persists maxSeenCoordinatorEpoch and rejects the old epoch (tests across both sides)
allUnrevokedAckedNewEpoch is computed from recorded acks, never supplied by the caller (test)
validation: Directed regressions in the named test files
escalation: Material acceptance/effort expansion or distinct outcome splitting requires owner agreement
Never let two coordinators act, or copy context as authority, to make progress
